research_summary: The Dutch accounting software market is dominated by local providers tailored to Dutch tax requirements (BTW/VAT, UBL invoicing), with Exact Online leading at ~400,000 users. Strong preference for cloud-based solutions among 500,000+ ZZP (freelancers) and SMEs, with pricing typically €8-€40/month for local solutions.
market_observations: Strong local provider dominance due to Dutch GAAP, BTW/VAT automation, UBL/Peppol e-invoicing requirements. International players (Xero, FreshBooks, QuickBooks) have lower adoption due to less Dutch-specific compliance features and higher pricing.
